body.name: IAM
body.description: Roles and Groups. People request, review, grant and remove access, and manage active privileged roles. Effective assignments always come from the protected Access source.

permissions.label: Request access
permissions.description: Allows creating and submitting access requests.

permissions.label: Manage IAM
permissions.description: Administrative management of the IAM application.

permissions.label: Read IAM people
permissions.description: Read the IAM people directory under current account authority.

permissions.label: Read IAM roles
permissions.description: Read IAM roles under current role authority.

permissions.label: Read IAM groups
permissions.description: Read IAM groups under current group authority.

permissions.label: Read IAM group memberships
permissions.description: Read IAM group memberships under current group authority.

permissions.label: Read IAM role assignments
permissions.description: Read IAM role assignments under current assignment authority.

permissions.label: Read IAM role activations
permissions.description: Read IAM role activations under current role authority.

permissions.label: Read IAM delegations
permissions.description: Read IAM delegations under current assignment authority.

permissions.label: Read installed applications
permissions.description: Read currently reachable installed applications when choosing an application role template.

permissions.label: Read application role templates
permissions.description: Read currently available application role templates through the protected role catalogue.

props.title: My profile
props.text: Change your own display name, language and time zone. Changing another person's profile needs the manage-accounts permission. Each change runs under your own authority in protected Access and is checked against the revision you read.

props.title: IAM overview
props.text: Access requests describe intent; approval decisions are made by workflows. Only protected Access determines current people, roles, groups and assignments; those views read live protected Access data and are never copied into records.

props.title: People
props.text: Read live from protected Identity and Access data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records.

props.title: Roles and Groups
props.text: Read live from protected Identity and Access data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records.

props.title: Assignments
props.text: Read live from protected Identity and Access data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records.

props.title: Manage roles and Groups
props.text: Create an empty Group or a custom role. Install or upgrade applications in App Store to accept their roles. Revising a role, renaming a Group, changing Group memberships and ending a role, Group or membership start from the row actions on Roles and Groups. Each change runs under your own authority in protected Access, is checked against the revision you read, and is refused if you lack the authority or if it exceeds your delegated scope.

props.name: privilege_classification
props.label: Privilege classification
props.help_text: standard or privileged. Administrative permissions require privileged.

props.name: permission_references
props.label: Permission references
props.help_text: JSON array of exact permission references. Each entry names ownerKind, ownerId and permissionId, plus applicationRootId when the owner is an application or module.

props.title: Active roles
props.text: Review privileged role activations available under your current authority. Use a row action to deactivate an activation.
